title: Alight Benefits Intelligence launches to help employers make better benefits decisions
summary: Connected data across fragmented sources gives employers a clearer view of benefits performance and where opportunities exist across their complete set of programs.
body_markdown:
**Alight, Inc. (NYSE: ALIT)** , a leading benefits administration provider of health, wealth and leave solutions, today announced[Alight Benefits Intelligence](https://www.alight.com/solutions/health-benefits/alight-benefits-intelligence) , a new solution that connects fragmented benefits data across carriers, vendors and point solutions to help employers understand program performance, identify opportunities and make more informed benefits decisions.


Available today, Alight Benefits Intelligence builds on the Data Engine capabilities added through Alight’s recent acquisition of Abett. Connecting data from a growing set of over 140 sources, including medical claims, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) and point solutions, Alight Benefits Intelligence gives benefits leaders a clearer view of program performance, costs and outcomes. Employers can use those insights to track enrollment and engagement to understand the impact and inform what to do next. For example, an employer could connect data from a musculoskeletal health program with claims and engagement information to identify eligible groups for outreach, then track enrollment and engagement over time.


"Employers are investing significantly in benefits, but the data is spread across plans, systems and vendors, making the whole picture difficult to see," said Rohit Verma, CEO at Alight. "Alight Benefits Intelligence brings participant-level data together in a single, governed foundation, giving employers a clearer view of performance, where opportunities exist and where to focus next."


**How Alight Benefits Intelligence helps HR and benefits teams**


- **See what’s working.** Bring together and normalize data across the benefits ecosystem to compare program utilization, trends and available measures of success. This helps benefits leaders determine which programs to maintain, expand, improve or reconsider.
- **Know where to focus.** Connect authorized data across programs to identify employee cohorts that may benefit from more support and uncover gaps or opportunities that may not be visible when programs are evaluated independently.
- **Act and measure.** Target employee outreach to connect priority populations with relevant programs and resources through Alight or employer channels. Track enrollment, engagement and available outcomes to assess what is working and refine the approach over time.


Alight Benefits Intelligence is available as a standalone offering or can be integrated with Alight Worklife®. Learn more about Alight Benefits Intelligence[here](https://www.alight.com/solutions/health-benefits/alight-benefits-intelligence) .
